entries.title: Admin, ban & kick + anti-spam + better ping (v2)
points: NEW: Room host/admin — first person in a room is the admin. Right-click any person (or tile) for Kick, Ban, Disconnect, Transfer host.
NEW: Ban system blocks the device + IP for the room (default 60 min). Kicked/banned users see a reason and cannot rejoin while banned.
NEW: Anti multi-account — one device = one account per room. A second tab from the same device replaces the old one instead of flooding the room.
Anti-spam: duplicate messages, link/emoji floods, burst sending and slow-mode mute after repeated spam.
Ping: median + smoothing algorithm, adaptive refresh (fast when network is poor), monotonic clock — numbers are steadier and truer.
Sounds: 10 new sounds (message, mention, join, leave, error, kick, ban, success, click, blip) in public/sounds/ with volume control.
Protection: per-IP connection caps, stricter upload checks (double-extension blocked), same-origin guard, stronger security headers.
FIX: faster dead-peer detection (8s ping / 12s timeout) and WebSocket-first transport for lower latency.

entries.title: Stability + ping card
points: Live ping counter with average, jitter and sparkline chart in the Connection card.
Join gate no longer hangs; draft messages are kept per room.
Edit/delete your messages, pin messages, search chat.

entries.title: Voice FX + themes
points: Mic presets (Voice / Podcast / Gaming / Quiet), noise gate, amplification and device picker.
Light / dark / auto themes, text size, density and focus mode.
